project.name: Kirkton of Monikie
project.boundarySource: Mapped named-place location with a conservative editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: All 13 HES/NRHE records retained: eight local dated records visible, two dated external-buffer records hidden and three undated records hidden. Angus-wide full audit completed 2026-09-01: all six visitor categories, the four named commercial trail providers, current official/conventional routes, strict-boundary scoring and local HES/NRHE integrity were checked.

touristAppeal.label: Selector only
touristAppeal.summary: Kirkton of Monikie has a coherent historic churchyard group and several archaeological records, but it is a tiny rural settlement without a verified café, promoted trail, picnic facility, public visitor parking or toilet. Monikie Country Park is a separate destination and does not support this score.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: No reliable current dog policy for the churchyard was found.

visitorHighlights.name: Monikie Parish Kirk and Churchyard
visitorHighlights.reason: A coherent, source-rich churchyard group with medieval origins and several dated structures, but a modest exterior-led visitor experience.

townGuide.headline: A compact historic kirk group
townGuide.intro: Kirkton of Monikie scores 38% and remains selector-only. Visit for the churchyard group, not for the facilities of Monikie Country Park, which is a separate destination.
